articles.title: Tesla Begins High-Volume Semi Production at Nevada Factory, Musk Says
articles.summary: Tesla Inc (NASDAQ:TSLA) has begun “high volume production” of its electric Semi truck at a new factory in Nevada, chief executive Elon Musk said on Thursday, with the company targeting annual production of 50,000 units. Tesla formally inaugurated the facility in Sparks, Nevada, at an event on Thursday evening.
